duplicates.method: Float64 numerical equality, signed-zero-canonical SHA-256 index with direct equality confirmation for every duplicate group.

scaling.method: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler, population variance (ddof=0), fitted on training rows only for both predictors and target.

split.component_label: Minimum zero-based original row index in each connected component; sklearn GroupShuffleSplit orders distinct component labels ascending.
split.component_labels_hash_encoding: Full original-row component label array, little-endian signed int64, SHA-256.
split.grouping_algorithm: Union-find transitive closure of equality edges for each of the two complete float64 vectors; no normalization, tolerance, formula parsing, target grouping, or row removal.
split.index_hash_encoding: Contiguous original-row index array, little-endian signed int64, SHA-256.
split.row_index_basis: Zero-based original train.csv row, excluding header; unique_m.csv row correspondence verified by exact critical_temp equality.
split.rule: GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=0) on connected components linked by identical supplied elemental composition vectors OR identical supplied 81-predictor vectors.
